title: List of Deadwood episodes
wikipedia_extract: Deadwood, a Western drama television series created by David Milch, premiered on the premium television channel HBO in the United States on March 21, 2004, and ended on August 27, 2006. The series consists of a total of 36 episodes over three 12-episode seasons; the episodes are approximately 55 minutes. A film continuation premiered on May 31, 2019.
